title: fix(components,plugin-detail,app-shell,i18n): a record action disabled by its predicate says why it is unavailable (objectui#11811)
body:
Fixes #11811

Clause-②: yes

A record action greyed out by its declared `disabled` predicate now says why. It shows the generic reason "Not available for this record" as a tooltip, on hover and on keyboard focus, and the same text is its accessible description (`aria-describedby`). Before, the button carried no tooltip, no `title` and no description.

## Where the card's defect actually lives

The claim's original Responsibility line named `DeclaredActionsBar` as the code that draws the showcase Task page's *Archive*. It does not: `DeclaredActionsBar` renders only `sys_approval_request` actions (record page approvals bar, approvals inbox). Measured on objectstack `main` (the card's `879bd38c` is its ancestor), the Task page (`showcase_task_detail`, `kind: 'full'`) draws Archive in two other renderers:

- **the header**: a `page:header` node whose `actions` are ids, drawn by `PageHeaderRenderer`'s `renderButton` (`@object-ui/components`);
- **the section bar**: `record:quick_actions` at `location: 'record_section'`, drawn by `QuickActionButton` (`@object-ui/plugin-detail`).

The seat recorded the correction in claim amendment 6049093782 and added the header file to the surface. `DeclaredActionsBar` has the same defect class, so it gets the same fix.

## What changed

- `page:header` (`packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`): the inline button gets a tooltip trigger plus an `sr-only` description. In the ⋯ overflow menu the reason is a visible second line under the label and is the item's `aria-describedby`; the item's name stays the label (`aria-labelledby`). A tooltip there would be out of keyboard reach: the menu's roving focus skips a disabled item (`focusable: !disabled`) and the menu traps Tab. **Only an authored action's declared `disabled`** gets the reason. The host-injected Edit and Delete (`RecordContext.headerSystemActions`, a host-computed boolean) and the inline-edit lock are unchanged. Authored and host actions are told apart by key, from the dedupe that lets an authored action win.
- `record:quick_actions` (`QuickActionButton`) and `DeclaredActionsBar`: the same tooltip trigger and description on the inline button.
- One new key, `actions.notAvailableForRecord`, with real translations in all ten packs.

**Why a wrapper span.** A natively `disabled` button fires no pointer or focus events, and the Button primitive adds `disabled:pointer-events-none`, so a tooltip or a native `title` on the button itself never opens. The span is the tooltip trigger, the pattern Radix documents for a disabled trigger. It takes the hover, and `tabIndex={0}` lets a keyboard user focus it. Both the button and the span carry `aria-describedby` pointing at a persistent `sr-only` copy, so a screen reader gets the reason with the tooltip closed. The repo had no disabled-tooltip pattern. Its `title`-on-disabled-Button sites cannot show at all; a Chromium probe found that the hit target at a `pointer-events: none` disabled button's centre is its parent.

**Not changed:** a button greyed out only while its own action runs (spinner) shows no reason. No export, prop or type member is added. The author-written reason beside the predicate is a spec key for objectstack, not part of this PR.

## Tests (head `e165c34`)

- New pins, three files: `page-header-disabledReason-11811.test.tsx` (7), `record-quick-actions.disabledReason-11811.test.tsx` (7), `DeclaredActionsBar.disabledReason-11811.test.tsx` (7).
  - **Disabled by the predicate:** the button is disabled and described by the reason; hover opens `role=tooltip`; Tab reaches the trigger, which opens it.
  - **Controls:** a predicate that does not hold gives no reason; a running or loading button gives no reason; the header's host Edit and Delete with `disabled: true` give no reason.
  - **Overflow:** the item shows the reason and is described by it.
  - **Text:** the zh pack and the en pack.
  - **Fixture:** the predicate is the served CEL envelope. The bare string goes to the legacy evaluator, where `has()` faults and a fail-soft `disabled` greys out both rows, so it would pin the wrong reason.
- `vitest run packages/components/` plus the 36 app-shell, console and example files that name `page:header`, `PageHeaderRenderer` or `headerSystemActions`, at `e165c34`: `Test Files 401 passed | 1 skipped (402)`.
- `vitest run packages/plugin-detail/ packages/i18n/` plus the 27 app-shell and console files that name `DeclaredActionsBar`, `record-quick-actions` or the key, at `e2a498f`: `Test Files 356 passed | 1 skipped (357)`. `e165c34` changes no file in those packages.
- type-check: `@object-ui/components` exit 0 at `e165c34`; `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/plugin-detail` and `@object-ui/app-shell` exit 0 at `e2a498f`, on dists rebuilt from this branch.
- **Ablations**, run after commit through objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: the anchor `if (!disabledReason) return button;` is replaced by an unconditional `return button;`.
  - Header: `Tests 4 failed | 3 passed (7)`. Red: description, hover, focus, zh. Green: overflow and both controls.
  - Quick actions and `DeclaredActionsBar`: `Tests 10 failed | 4 passed (14)`. Red: description, hover, focus, zh, en on each. Green: the controls.
  - Each restore was proven: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- Gates at `e165c34`, all exit 0:
  - i18n: `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` (1 key added, no en value changed), `check:i18n-dead-keys` (report; the new key is not a candidate), `check:i18n-designer-parity`;
  - changeset: `check-changeset-presence` (4 released packages, 1 changeset), `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`;
  - other: `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new); eslint on touched files (0 errors).
- **Not run locally:** the full app-shell suite. The named-file sets above cannot see a suite that draws these renderers through a page tree without naming them; CI runs the full farm.

## Changeset

`.changeset/11811-disabled-action-reason.md`: `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/components` are `minor`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/plugin-detail` are `patch`. The fixed group publishes all of them at `minor`, never `major`. The body names the three surfaces and the one key.

## Acceptance notes

- The generic action renderers (`action:button` / `action:icon` / `action:group` / `action:menu`) have the same gap. They are their own family card, objectui#11839, and this PR leaves them alone.
- A `disabled` predicate that faults (fail-soft) also greys the action out, and now also shows the generic reason. That is consistent, since the action is unavailable either way, but the wording slightly overstates the case for a broken predicate.
- `InlineEditSaveBar`'s Save button sets `title` on a disabled Button, which cannot show for the pointer-events reason above. The approval-lock band already shows that reason on screen. Noted only.
- Overlap: #11836 adds keys to the same ten packs. Whoever lands second merges `main`.
